issues.summary: XML doc comment on PdfExporter.Title claimed 'Defaults to the report name' but the property is null by default with no constructor assignment.
issues.resolution: Rewrote the doc comment to state that Title is null by default and that ExportAsync forwards non-null/non-whitespace values to the /Info dictionary via Document.AddTitle. No runtime behaviour change; no constructor assignment added because that would change behaviour for existing callers.
